transcript.content: Hello. I am a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

I've just been feeling so incredibly sad and empty inside for the past five months, and it's gotten too difficult to cope with. Everything feels completely heavy and exhausting. I just don't know what to do anymore.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually happy, energetic, or like you didn't need much sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I've never had times where I felt unusually happy or full of energy. It has really only been the opposite, just feeling constantly down and exhausted.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't see or hear, or had beliefs that others found very unusual?

Yes, to be honest... I've been hearing whispering voices when no one is around, and sometimes I see dark shapes moving in the corner of my room. I also can't shake the feeling that people on the street are constantly watching me and talking about me, even though everyone tells me I'm just being paranoid.
Have you ever heard those whispering voices or felt watched during times when you were not feeling depressed or sad?

Yes, I have. There was a period of about two weeks where my mood actually felt pretty normal and I wasn't feeling depressed, but I still heard the whispering and felt like I was being watched. It was strange because even though the sadness lifted for a bit, those experiences didn't go away.
How long in total have you been experiencing these whispering voices and feelings of being watched?
It has been going on for about a year and eleven months now, almost two years in total. It's just so exhausting carrying this around for that long. I feel like it's never going to stop.

During these past two years that you've had the voices and feelings of being watched, have you had other periods of deep sadness, or is this current five-month period the only time you've felt depressed?

Yes, I've definitely had other periods of deep sadness over the last two years. This current five-month stretch isn't the first time, as I've fallen into that heavy, empty feeling a few other times before this. It feels like the depression just keeps coming back.
If you add up all those periods of deep sadness over the last two years, including this current five-month period, about how many months in total would you say you have felt depressed?

Out of the nearly two years I've been dealing with all of this, I have felt depressed for the majority of that time. When I add up all those periods of deep sadness, it comes out to about 14 or 15 months in total. It really feels like I've been down more often than not.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type) and Schizophrenia. The patient reports having psychotic symptoms (whispering voices and paranoia) for nearly two years, and during this time, they have experienced depressive episodes for a total of 14-15 months (the majority of the illness duration). They also experienced psychotic symptoms for a period of two weeks in the absence of depressive symptoms. Since the mood episodes have been present for the majority of the total duration of the illness, the diagnosis of Schizophrenia is ruled out, leaving Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type) as the definitive diagnosis.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient exhibits both psychotic symptoms (hallucinations and delusions) and depressive symptoms. The psychotic symptoms have been present for nearly two years, including a period of at least two weeks in the absence of any major mood symptoms, which distinguishes this from Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features.
